cutover_gates: Automation API 1.0 is implemented and released.
All seven existing Studio feature capabilities are available and contract-tested.
Studio has dispatcher-based implementations for every existing Automation-backed workflow.
Success, planned, blocked, error, and supported progress-event contracts are tested.
Post-operation authoritative-state reconciliation remains in place.
Compatibility and upgrade messaging is complete.
End-to-end migration tests cover the Studio 1.0 and Automation 1.3.0 baseline.
notes: This version-controlled file is the approved build-time compatibility policy design for the first API-enabled Studio release.
Release builds validate and bundle this declaration as an immutable application resource; production does not load a user-editable replacement.
At runtime Studio compares this bundled policy with jl-mixing system-info --json to derive the current compatibility state.
system.info is required to enter Automation API mode; missing workflow capabilities disable only their corresponding Studio features.
Studio reports compatible full-functionality, compatible limited-functionality, incompatible, and Automation-unavailable states.
Compatibility policy changes require a reviewed source change, compatibility tests, and a new Studio release.
Studio 1.0.x remains tied to JL Mixing Automation 1.3.0 until a later Studio release completes the approved clean cutover to Automation API 1.0.
The API-enabled release does not invoke individual legacy Automation executables as a fallback.
